title: 计费重量与体积重
keywords: 体积重 重量 尺寸 dimensional volumetric weight dimensions rounding
text: 厘米尺寸体积重为长×宽×高÷5000。每件取实重与体积重较高者，再按费率档向上取整。本原型处理单件自备包装，按 0.5kg 档位核算。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: Volumetric weight is length × width × height in cm divided by 5000. Use the higher of actual and volumetric weight, then round up to the next rate break. This prototype handles one customer-packaged parcel in 0.5 kg steps.

title: 美国目的地分区
keywords: 美国 加州 纽约 邮编 分区 California New York ZIP zone state
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: The retained zone chart assigns western US ZIP ranges to zone 1: CO 80000–81699, ID 83200–83999, UT 84000–84799, AZ 85000–86599, NV 89000–89899, CA 90000–96699, OR 97000–97999 and WA 98000–99499. Other US destinations use zone 2.

title: 公开费率适用范围
keywords: 报价 价格 费用 广东 福建 上海 账户 折扣 price rates Guangdong Fujian Shanghai eligibility
text: 当前参考表适用于广东、福建以外的中国出口地区，具有客户账户与中国付款资格条件。已提取 IPE、IP、IE 自备包装 0.5–20.5kg 档位。结果为公开参考表的已知费用估算。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: The retained public table covers China exports outside Guangdong and Fujian, subject to account and China-payer eligibility. IPE, IP and IE customer-packaged rates from 0.5 to 20.5 kg are extracted. Outputs are known reference-cost estimates.

title: 燃油附加费
keywords: 燃油 附加费 fuel surcharge percent
text: 燃油百分比按周调整。本地未核验当周数值。情景参数只按基础运费计算；当期百分比及燃油适用的附加费范围仍需核对。未填写时保留燃油待确认项。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: Fuel percentages change weekly. The current week has not been verified. An optional scenario percentage applies to base freight only; the actual fuel surcharge and applicable surcharge base need confirmation.

title: 偏远地区与住宅派送
keywords: 偏远 住宅 派送 remote residential ODA
text: 派送偏远地区费 A 档为 23 CNY；B 档取 171 CNY 与 3.90 CNY/kg 较高者；C 档取 222 CNY 与 5.10 CNY/kg 较高者。美国非重货住宅费为 24 CNY；收取 ODA 时住宅费不再另收。具体地址的档位需另行确认。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: ODA delivery fees: tier A CNY 23; tier B the higher of CNY 171 and CNY 3.90/kg; tier C the higher of CNY 222 and CNY 5.10/kg. US non-freight residential delivery is CNY 24, not added when ODA applies. Address eligibility must be confirmed.

title: 非标准尺寸与包装
keywords: 超长 超重 大件 包装 oversize handling carton packaging
text: 附加操作尺寸条件包括最长边大于 121cm、第二长边大于 76cm、长度加围长大于 266cm，或体积大于 169901cm³。此时涉及额外费用和最低计费重量；当前普通小包核算转为人工确认。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: Additional handling size conditions include longest side over 121 cm, second side over 76 cm, length plus girth over 266 cm or volume over 169901 cubic cm. These parcels need additional-charge and minimum-weight review.

title: 美国入境处理费
keywords: 美国 入境 处理费 inbound processing
text: 保留的附加费来源表对目的地为美国的货件列示每票 19.30 CNY 入境处理费。原型将此来源版本项目单列；税费与其他清关服务费用另行核对。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: The retained surcharge table lists a US inbound processing fee of CNY 19.30 per shipment. Taxes and other clearance charges remain separate.

title: 商业发票字段
keywords: 商业发票 单证 必填 invoice shipper consignee required documents
text: 官方指南围绕寄件人、收件人、进口人和货品组织商业发票。货品明细包括具体描述、数量、单价、金额、币种和原产地。项目检查联系人、地址、行金额与合计，并保留进口人、HS 编码和签字供复核。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: The commercial invoice guide covers shipper, consignee, importer and goods. Item details include description, quantity, unit value, amount, currency and origin. This project checks basic contacts and arithmetic; importer, HS codes and signature require review.

title: 货品描述与 HS 编码
keywords: 货物 描述 材质 用途 HS code gifts parts description material
text: 货品描述应说明是什么、材质和用途，避免只写 gifts 或 parts。HS 编码需要正确分类依据，草稿保留用户提供的编码，缺失时标注待核对。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: Describe the item, material and use rather than gifts or parts. Preserve user-provided HS codes for review; the prototype does not classify goods.

title: 发票与装箱单一致性
keywords: 装箱单 数量 核对 packing list quantities mismatch consistency
text: 根据官方单证信息一致性原则，本项目逐项比对发票与装箱单的描述和数量，再以数量乘单价核对合计。检查结果指出具体行与修正项。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: The project compares invoice and packing-list descriptions and quantities, then checks line amounts and the declared total. Differences are reported for correction.

title: 物流状态与官方示例
keywords: 物流 单号 运单 派送 签收 跟踪 tracking delivered pending sample
text: Ship24 提供原始事件和标准化状态。SHIP24_SAMPLE_DELIVERED_000 是官方模拟运单，当前演示使用已保存的四个节点：创建运单、到仓、派送和送达。 示例轨迹位于法国，与当前中国至美国任务无关联。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: Ship24 provides events and normalized statuses. SHIP24_SAMPLE_DELIVERED_000 is an official synthetic sample. The saved demonstration has four events: label created, warehouse arrival, out for delivery and delivered.

title: 时效与服务覆盖
keywords: 时效 几天 截止 日期 到达 deadline arrival transit IPE
text: 费率表提供参考价格，未给出当前地址的预计到达日；IPE 需要核对具体目的地邮区覆盖。原型保留用户截止日期，并将能否满足时效列为承运人待确认项。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: The rate table does not provide a current address-specific arrival date. IPE postal-code coverage needs confirmation. A saved delivery deadline remains a carrier-confirmation item.

title: 危险品与电池物品
keywords: 电池 危险品 液体 battery dangerous goods liquid restricted
text: 来源表列明 IE 不承运危险品。含电池、液体等物品需要确认具体类别、包装和承运条件；本原型发现相关描述时请求人工核对。
scope: 中国出口小包参考资料
text_en: The retained table states IE does not accept dangerous goods. Batteries and liquids need category, packaging and service-acceptance review before selecting services.
